behavior: Only an active matching device generation may revoke its command lane and invalidate the broker. Stale and repeated revocations have no external side effect.
environment: Xcode 26.6 RC; frozen private source checkout, isolating unrelated live Mac lifecycle edits. Final lane and test sources match these hashes.
scope: Old implementation fails both connection-preservation and subsequent command-admission assertions.
Fixed implementation completes a context command after pristine generation rebind; matching revocation still invalidates once, repeated revocation does not invalidate again.
limitations: Bounded asynchronous observations are not a general concurrency soak.
Does not implement renderer replacement after GPU commands have been admitted.
No physical accelerated guest qualification in this batch.
